events.place: Chilczyce, Bezirk Złoczów, Kingdom of Galicia and Lodomeria, Austria-Hungary

citations.text:
Grocer residing in store at 653 Selkirk Avenue in 1946.

Resided at her grocery store at 653 Selkirk Avenue in 1940.

Resided at 502 McKenzie Street and worked for the Fort Garry Hotel in 1947.

Place of origin is also given as "Ciszki circ. Zotoczine" in daughter Helen's Church baptism records.

Catharine was given as being baptised in the Ukraine in "1898" in church marriage records, and not born in 1899 as the tombstone indicates.

Obituary appeared in the Winnipeg Free Press on January 5, 1981:

Resided at 465 Galloway Street at the time of her death in 1981.

Had 4 grandchildren and 3 great grandchildren by 1981.

Prayers were said at 7:00 pm, January 7, 1981 at Cropo Funeral Home.

Mass was said at 10:00 am on January 7, 1981at Blessed Virgin Mary (Boyd) Church. Rev. R.M. Dobriansky officiated.
